== Description ==

[[Brian Fred]] (left, bald, glasses, white Colts sleeveless jersey, large left-shoulder tattoo), [[Benji Chu]] (standing mid, black SWCCG cap, Team Albany tee, leaning over the table), [[Jonny Chu]] (mid, glasses, short dark hair, black hoodie, in profile), and [[Charlie Arlandson]] (right, shaved head, beard, black eagle graphic hoodie, red card sleeves) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
